_about: The scored-cell rules of challenge_description.md, section 'Which cells are scored', as data for bench/metric_parity.py (#68, #82).
This file is the only place in that check where a dimension or class is named; every name is validated against galaxus.data.classes when it loads.
Rules are triggered by human labels only: a model prelabel never triggers a rule (challenge_description.md).

not_scored_when.quote: subject logo, placeholder or energy_label: background, perspective, individuals and text_classification are not scored
subject infographic: background, perspective and individuals are not scored
subject delivery_scope, detail_closeup or product_grouping: perspective is not scored
background scene_lifestyle: subject and perspective are not scored

scored_only_if.quote: text_language is scored only when a text overlay is present, or subject is infographic, packaging, package_and_product or full_product
